label: Best in Class
corporate_parent: Boa-Franc Inc. (Mirage brand) — independent, privately held. St-Georges, Québec, Canada.
manufacturing_location: St-Georges, Québec, Canada — single-source Canadian manufacturing

veneer_specification.description: 3.5mm sawn white oak veneer — supports 1-2 proper sandings plus screen/recoat cycles. Sawn cut provides authentic grain pattern indistinguishable from solid hardwood.

core_construction.description: Baltic birch plywood core — gold standard for engineered hardwood. No voids, excellent adhesion, superior dimensional stability. Cross-grain orientation balances internal stresses.
core_construction.adhesive: Premium adhesive system — specific formulation proprietary. ANSI/HPVA bond test compliant.

finish_system.description: NanoLinx finish — multi-layer UV-cured aluminum oxide with nano-particle enhancement. 7+ coats of UV-cured finish including aluminum oxide layers for maximum scratch and wear resistance. Industry-leading finish adhesion.

milling_precision.description: Installer consensus ranks Mirage as the gold standard for tongue-and-groove milling precision. Boards fit together with minimal to no gaps, reducing lippage and filler requirements. Tightest tolerance in the factory-finished engineered category.

source_traceability.description: Single-source manufacturing in St-Georges, Québec. Domestic North American hardwood sourcing. Full chain of custody.

performance_evidence.dimensional_stability: Excellent — multi-ply Baltic birch cross-grain construction provides superior dimensional stability. Suitable for radiant heat, basements (above-grade), and wide plank applications.
performance_evidence.refinishing_potential: 1-2 proper sandings — 3.5mm sawn veneer allows professional refinishing but not unlimited like 3/4" solid. Wire-brushed Sweet Memories texture slightly reduces effective sanding depth.
performance_evidence.moisture_resistance: Standard engineered — multi-ply construction is more moisture-tolerant than solid but not waterproof. Not for wet areas.
performance_evidence.installation_versatility: All methods — glue-down, nail/staple, float over plywood, concrete, or existing floor. Maximum application versatility.
performance_evidence.finish_scratch_resistance: Excellent — NanoLinx nano-particle aluminum oxide finish outperforms standard aluminum oxide in scratch resistance testing per installer consensus.
performance_evidence.radiant_heat: Mirage certified for radiant heat installations with approved underlayment and temperature protocols.

finish_warranty.description: 35-year residential finish warranty covering wear-through to bare wood under normal residential use.

structural_warranty.description: Lifetime residential structural warranty against manufacturing defects including delamination.

delamination_risk.notes: Baltic birch core + premium adhesive system — no documented delamination patterns in professional community. Quality control at St-Georges facility consistently cited as excellent.

formaldehyde.status: CARB Phase 2 certified, Greenguard Gold certified
formaldehyde.certifier: Third-party certified — specific lab to confirm in deep dive

durability_evidence.warranty_claim_process: Dealer-supported warranty claims through authorized Mirage dealer network.

safety_evidence.formaldehyde: Greenguard Gold certified — stricter than CARB Phase 2 for formaldehyde and total VOC emissions.
safety_evidence.voc_emissions: Low — UV-cured finish off-gasses primarily during factory manufacturing. Post-install VOC levels meet Greenguard Gold thresholds.
safety_evidence.lacey_act: North American hardwood sourcing from identified domestic suppliers.

platform_disclosure.cross_brand: None — Boa-Franc (Mirage) is an independent manufacturer. No badge engineering.
